The Edo period is nearing its end. Gabimaru, a shinobi formerly known as the strongest in Iwagakure who is now a death row convict, is told that he will be acquitted and set free if he can bring back the Elixir of Life from an island that is rumored to be the Buddhist pure land Sukhavati. In hopes of reuniting with his beloved wife, Gabimaru heads to the island along with the executioner Yamada Asaemon Sagiri. Upon arriving there, they encounter other death row convicts in search of the Elixir of Life... as well as a host of unknown creatures, eerie manmade statues, and the hermits who rule the island. Can Gabimaru find the Elixir of Life on this mysterious island and make it back home alive?

128516.description:
Episode 1 - Tooi Kimi ni, Boku wa Todokanai
Ryoka Yotsumoto and Ayumu Matsuzono were childhood friends. Ayumu secretly harbored a faint crush on Ryoka. Ryoka told Ayumu that she was still seeing Yamato Aihara—the boy who had rescued her when she was being harassed by a group from the karate club—and that he had asked her to go out with him. Without a shred of suspicion, Ryoka allowed herself to be seduced by Yamato and surrendered her innocent body to him. It was a blissful first time—but it was actually a cunning trap that exploited Ryoka’s innocence. In the room next door, the karate club members had been spying on the entire scene, and Ayumu was being held captive there as well. Witnessing Ryoka’s transformation right before his eyes, Ayumu’s mind was consumed by madness, and he plummeted into the depths of despair…

Episode 2 - Zeni no Shikaku: Sono Hi Iinchou no Junketsu wa Ubawareta...
Class president Mizuki Naruse couldn’t stand by and watch as her classmate Yui Maeda was being raped by a group of male students, so, driven by a sense of justice, she went to the location they designated after school. Mizuki chooses to offer her own body in exchange for making the male students promise never to have anything to do with Yui again. “This is a consensual act; it is by no means rape”. Even as she is forced to declare this in front of the camera and is molested by the male students, she maintains a resolute demeanor. However, as her hymen is torn and she is penetrated repeatedly, she gradually begins to notice changes in her body.

(Source: Mediabank, translated)

128890.description:
IDOLiSH7 is more successful than ever, but no one is smiling because a new threat has taken the stage: the debuting idol group ŹOOĻ. Managed by the nefarious entertainment executive Ryou Tsukumo, they will stop at nothing to get their way, resorting to all kinds of underhanded tactics to bring down their rivals. TRIGGER's image has already been ruined by scandal, and IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale are headed for the same fate—or worse.

Meanwhile, Zero, the legendary idol who disappeared 15 years ago, continues to haunt the present through those he left behind. His manager seems to be in contact with Tsukumo for his own schemes, and Zero's songwriter reveals himself in a letter after having been missing for years. IDOLiSH7 finds an ally in Re:vale to thwart ŹOOĻ's plans while trying to make sense of Zero's colleagues' actions, but it may be impossible for everyone to emerge unscathed.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Ryou and Souma—who revealed their feelings for each other—have finally started dating. When they thought their hearts and bodies were more deeply connected during their lovey dovey days, her ex-boyfriend Rei came to where they work. The three are reminded of their school days when their feelings grew apart. Ryou doesn't want to get involved, but will her heart choose a different path?

128713.description:
Music video produced by Cover Corp for the first official song of the hololive IDOL PROJECT, Shiny Smily Story, perfomed by the many vTuber talents of Hololive Production.

Note: This song was originally teased at Comiket 96, then later uploaded to YouTube on August 15, 2019 as a special music video related to Hololive Summer '19.

This music video is a newer full version of the song, produced to tease hololive's 1st Fes. concert 'Nonstop Story', which took place on January 24, 2020. It was then repurposed to advertise hololive's 2nd Fes. concert 'Beyond The Stage', and then again for hololive IDOL PROJECT's 1st Live event, Bloom, which took place on February 17, 2021.
